title: Text & Markdown to PDF
description: Typeset pasted text or Markdown into a paginated A4/Letter PDF inside the tab. Headings become bold section titles and long documents break across pages. It does not open.docx files — a Word file has to be copied in as text first.
x-privacyfold-engine: none (plain JavaScript in the browser tab)

input.description: Text to process. Sent to the tool only through the URL fragment / local input.
